binding_strengths.meaning: Exact 4.4.54 AvatarID, SkillID, owner relation and level/config identity only; no executable behavior claim.
Exact SkillID/config is explicitly joined to an exact-version behavior record; a matching name or filename alone does not qualify.
Joined behavior plus exact or declared runtime inputs close every field and dependency of one supported REF02 settlement without invented arithmetic.
A reference-settlement-bound real skill is wrapped by a declared M10 local target, completion, schedule and terminal envelope; these fields retain SANDBOX_EXTENSION evidence.
The whole selectable action, target, effects, completion and schedule are closed by source evidence; not established in this CR.

promotion_gates.static_to_behavior: Require an explicit exact SkillID/config-to-behavior relation and version-qualified behavior identity. Avatar tag, ordinal suffix, localization text and close-version filename relations are insufficient.
promotion_gates.behavior_to_settlement: Require exact REF02 packet kind, target cardinality, amount base/factors, resource cost/owner, toughness delta, and closed survival/events with complete ordering and dependencies. Every numeric source must be pinned content or an explicitly required runtime state input; a local parameter must not impersonate game content.
promotion_gates.settlement_to_local_action: Require an M10-compatible versioned envelope, complete legal view, immutable publication, combat mutation, next decision context, and deterministic replay with binding provenance carried through envelope, step and plan identities.
promotion_gates.local_to_full_action: Require evidence for real action admission, target arbitration, effect closure, action completion and scheduler continuation; local envelope policies do not qualify.

version_policy: Exact Nanoka 4.4.54 static rows are not silently joined to close 4.4.0 behavior or artifacts with unverified runtime provenance.
blocked_runtime_policy: No ContentBoundReferenceAction or M10 envelope is emitted until REFERENCE_SETTLEMENT_BOUND passes. Discovery SQLite is not a session.step dependency. M10/M11 v1 schemas and identities remain unchanged.
forbidden_claims: full source-backed HSR action from a component
